summary.text: Qi howling painting world is one of two large paintings that appear inside Divine Emperor City's painting world, paired with growling beast painting world.

claims.text: Inside Divine Emperor City’s painting world, two newly added paintings draw exploration. Ye Fan probes growling beast painting world while Hong Yi inspects qi howling painting world. The two paintings have vast space relative to the limited central painting world and spark a wave of crazed exploration.

In qi howling painting world, Fang Di Chang and Beggar Sect face a huge pure-white elephant made of righteous qi that does not rampage but stares them down. Qi monsters take many shapes from many kinds of qi, with matching temperaments and strengths. Shen Shang later fights blood qi monsters, then the righteous qi elephant, until about ten thousand bull-shaped charging-bull-qi monsters stampede and force them to flee. Fang Di Chang expects the stampede to ruin the nearest camp and push exploration farther back.

Fang Di Chang and Shen Shang push deeper to find and communicate with Heavenly Court’s enemy at the depths of the painting. The painting world is too huge: Fang Di Chang’s strength is at a limit, and even Shen Shang’s rank eight cultivation is severely restricted, so the mortal-immortal gap is not evident. They never reach the deepest part before a rank eight Immortal Gu’s aura pulls them back to the central painting world.

During a huge outside disturbance, golden aurora forms two giant hands in the painting world’s sky. The left hand grabs qi howling painting world while the right grabs growling beast painting world, and Genesis Lotus’ will bursts painting path power to suppress them.
